data.long_meaning: Hasnat is an Arabic name that signifies good nature, virtue, and moral excellence. It is associated with positive qualities and character. The name Hasnat carries the meaning “Good Nature, Virtue” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasnat usually hope their child will grow to embody good nature, virtue and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasnat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
